# The Stellar Noir saved example, recorded in full

`answers.json` holds every answer the public testnet RPC gave on
2026-10-15 to a lookup of transaction
`10dd8ab5bcfbc8395030144cdfc5cb200ce61d38e7fad533e18e3aee89bbb3b2` (see
`../README.md`): the transaction with its result and events, and each
ledger entry the lookup read, by key, including the verifier contract's
code, from which its interface is read. The page replays it as a saved
example. Public data on a test network.
